images.title: Customs - All TerraGroup Cargo Locations
images.description: Overview map indicating the cargo locations on Customs, including the red warehouse, Boiler building, and Warehouse 17.

images.title: MS2000 Marker - Required Equipment
images.description: MS2000 Marker used to mark special TerraGroup cargo. Check the quest objectives for the required marking progress.
images.objective_id: Mark any of the special TerraGroup cargo boxes with an MS2000 Marker on Customs

images.title: Cargo 1 - Red Customs Warehouse
images.description: Cargo 1 is on the west side of the large red customs control warehouse (Big Red).
images.objective_id: Locate the first special TerraGroup cargo on Customs

images.title: Boiler Building - Location Map
images.description: Map showing the Boiler building, which contains cargo locations 2, 4, and 5.

images.title: Boiler Building - Exterior
images.description: Recognize the Boiler building on Customs before searching for cargo 2, 4, and 5.

images.title: Cargo 2 - Near the Showers
images.description: Cargo 2 is next to the shower area inside the Boiler building.
images.objective_id: Locate the second special TerraGroup cargo on Customs

images.title: Cargo 4 - Near the Chimneys
images.description: Cargo 4 consists of barrels beside the chimneys at the Boiler building.
images.objective_id: Locate the fourth special TerraGroup cargo on Customs

images.title: Cargo 5 - North Side of Boiler Building
images.description: Cargo 5 is outside on the north side of the Boiler building.
images.objective_id: Locate the fifth special TerraGroup cargo on Customs

images.title: Warehouse 17 - Location Map
images.description: Map showing Warehouse 17, where cargo 3, 6, and 7 are located.

images.title: Warehouse 17 - Building Reference
images.description: Identify Warehouse 17 and its southern entrance before searching its different floors.

images.title: Cargo 3 - Second-Floor Staircase
images.description: Cargo 3 is on the second floor of Warehouse 17, by the staircase behind the wall paintings.
images.objective_id: Locate the third special TerraGroup cargo on Customs

images.title: Cargo 6 - Third Floor or Crane Area
images.description: Cargo 6 is on the third-floor or crane area of Warehouse 17.
images.objective_id: Locate the sixth special TerraGroup cargo on Customs

images.title: Cargo 7 - First Floor
images.description: Cargo 7 is on the first floor of Warehouse 17.
images.objective_id: Locate the seventh special TerraGroup cargo on Customs
